verdict.rationale: Viam documents a built-in data manager that captures component output on the machine and sends it to the Viam cloud. That data is described as sensor data and telemetry you can collect, store and query. Data queues locally during outages and low-bandwidth conditions and syncs when connectivity returns, with restarts and storage limits handled automatically. Missing for 10: documented configurable bandwidth-aware sync policies (e.g., sync intervals, capture frequency, selective or prioritized sync), detailed data-capture configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
